baseShaDrift.detail: Expected-Base-SHA is the parent of HEAD; the single intervening commit (98d8ec4ab) is the parent task's own evidence-SHA bookkeeping under TB-SHIPPING-MVP-ADMIN-ROUNDTRIP-051. No source, contract, migration or config differs. Pre-existing unrelated dirty/untracked files preserved; no reset/stash/rebase/force-push.

migrationProduced: src/backend/Modules/Shipping/Tooba.Shipping.Infrastructure/Persistence/Migrations/20261014144742_InitialShipping.cs (+ .Designer.cs + ShippingDbContextModelSnapshot.cs) — scaffolded with `dotnet ef migrations add InitialShipping` through the existing 048 design-time factory; no csproj or factory change was needed.

invariantsEnforced.primaryKeys: ValueGeneratedNever on ShippingRatePolicy.RatePolicyId and ShippingCoverageGrant.CoverageGrantId (application-assigned UuidV7, replay-deterministic)
invariantsEnforced.notNull: service_code, currency_code, country_id, charge_amount, preparation_days, lead_days, is_active (rate) and service_code, country_id, is_active (grant); the four destination-scope columns stay nullable by design
checkConstraints: ck_rate_policies_service_code_canonical: non-empty and btrim-equal (the engine matches trimmed codes)
ck_rate_policies_scope_coherent / ck_coverage_grants_scope_coherent: service_area_id IS NULL OR city_id IS NOT NULL
invariantsEnforced.trueScopeUniqueness: ux_rate_policies_service_scope and ux_coverage_grants_service_scope on (service_code, country_id, administrative_area_id, city_id, service_area_id) are NULLS-NOT-DISTINCT unique indexes (EF: AreNullsDistinct(false) -> Npgsql:NullsDistinct=false -> literal `NULLS NOT DISTINCT` in DDL, confirmed by pg_index.indnullsnotdistinct = true). Without this, same-scope rows differing only by a NULL level would both insert and the engine would answer ScopeConflict for every request. Requires PostgreSQL 15+ (verified on 17.10, same major as the Development container); on an older server the migration fails loudly rather than degrading to a partial constraint.
invariantsEnforced.crossModule: no foreign key and no cross-schema reference: destination identity and service code remain plain ID/key values; asserted to be zero outbound FKs in both the model test and the applied schema.

noWeakening: The 048 pure fail-closed engine, the aggregates, the Contracts, the Fulfillment-owned /admin/shipping-services CRUD and the legacy checkout prices were not modified. No default rate/grant was seeded and no coverage was inferred from the legacy empty AllowedProvinces, so absent-row-is-uncovered is preserved. The new Shipping module remains UNWIRED from Host and MigrationRunner (no IModuleSchemaMigrator in the assembly, asserted by test).

focusedValidation.solutionBuild: dotnet build Tooba.slnx cannot complete while the Development Host runs: all 320 errors are MSB3027/MSB3021 file-copy locks naming Tooba.Host/bin/Debug/net8.0, with zero compiler diagnostics. The Task forbids restarting the Host, so it was left running. Tooba.Shipping.Infrastructure has exactly one consumer (the green test project) and the only external Shipping reference is the untouched Order.Application -> Shipping.Contracts edge, so the lock cannot hide a compile error here.

forbiddenPathsUntouched: No edits to Order/Checkout, Fulfillment, Geography, Host, MigrationRunner, shared BuildingBlocks, payments, settlements, frontend, appsettings, architecture guards or source-of-truth manifests; no Host DI registration, no MigrationRunner apply, no real tenant migration or seed, no shipping policy activation, no gate flips, no customer-facing rate or promise change, no new admin screen, no duplicated catalog CRUD.
limitations: The migration is review-only. Until the Architect authorizes Host wiring, ShippingModule registration, ModuleSchemaMigrationOrder insertion and an actual database update against the Development database, no Shipping rate or coverage can be stored, so 048's engine still has no data source and ship-time rates remain non-persisted.
NULLS NOT DISTINCT requires PostgreSQL 15+ (verified on 17.10). A future deployment on an older server would need an alternative formulation rather than the current migration.
No coverage grant row was created by design; the fail-closed default (uncovered) is preserved and grant authoring is still a separate deliverable.
